# SWE Agent System

A sophisticated AI-powered software engineering assistant leveraging multiple specialized agents for code editing, documentation generation, and project analysis.

## Overview

This system provides intelligent software development assistance using large language models with:
- Smart routing between coding and copy-writing workflows  
- Multi-agent orchestration
- Comprehensive backup and safety mechanisms
- Interactive web interface

## Core Components

### Main Agent Script (`agent.py`)
- Routes tasks to appropriate workflows (code vs copy)
- Communicates with local LLM server 
- Implements safety checks and file backup
- Integrates with llm-orc orchestration engine

### Web GUI Server (`gui_server.py`)
- Interactive web interface for task management
- File browsing and selection  
- Real-time progress monitoring via SSE
- History management

### Orchestration Engine (`.llm-orc/`)
- **Ensembles**: Workflow pipeline definitions
  - `code-workflow.yaml`: coder → code_critic agents
  - `copy-workflow.yaml`: writer → prose_critic agents
- Configuration and execution artifacts  

## System Architecture

The system uses specialized AI agents:
- **coder**: Expert software engineer implementation 
- **code_critic**: Senior review of code quality
- **writer**: Professional copywriting  
- **prose_critic**: Text formatting validation

## Installation & Setup

### Prerequisites
1. Python 3.8+ 
2. Local LLM server (e.g., LM Studio with Qwen models)
3. Node.js environment for llm-orc dependencies
4. Required packages: `pip install flask requests difflib pyyaml`

### Quick Start
```bash
# Install packages
pip install flask requests difflib pyyaml ddgs

# Run GUI server  
python gui_server.py
```

## Usage Examples

### Command Line
```bash
python agent.py "path/to/file.js" "Add error handling to this function"
python agent.py "src/main.py" "Write comprehensive docstrings"
```

### Web GUI 
1. `python gui_server.py`
2. Open browser to `http://localhost:5000`  

## Key Features

- Smart task routing (coding vs copy-writing)
- Multi-agent collaboration with safety validation
- Backup system and output verification  
- Real-time progress tracking via SSE
- Project context awareness through rule files

## Configuration Files

- **Workflow**: `code-workflow.yaml`, `copy-workflow.yaml`
- **Project Rules**: `AGENTS.md`, `.cursorrules`, `.clinerules`  

## Safety Features

1. Automatic backup creation (`.bak` files)
2. Output validation for suspiciously short responses  
3. HTML structure integrity checking
4. ANSI escape code filtering from agent outputs

## Technical Details

- Uses llm-orc orchestration engine
- REST API communication (`/v1/chat/completions`) 
- Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time updates
- Batch operations on multiple files  
- Supports both code and documentation editing

## Startup Scripts

The system includes several convenient startup scripts:

- **`Start-Agents.bat`**: Starts the core agent system 
- **`Start-GUI.bat`**: Launches the web GUI server
- **`Start-Server.bat`**: Starts the main server with all components  
- **`agent-cli.bat`**: Command-line interface for quick tasks
- **`run-agent.bat`**: Generic agent runner script
- **`start-orchestra.ps1`**: PowerShell script to start orchestration

## License

This project is designed as a tool for software engineering assistance.

                # 5. Extract content inside markdown code blocks if they exist

            backup_file.unlink()
        target_file.rename(backup_file)
        
        target_file.write_text(final_text, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"\n✅ Success! Updated {target_file.name} (Backup saved as {backup_file.name})")
        
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"\n❌ Orchestrator failed. Check {temp_out} for details.")

"""agents_md.py — per-role filtering of AGENTS.md / .cursorrules policy files.

Sections in policy files may be tagged with:

    <!-- applies-to: coder, writer -->

Untagged sections implicitly apply to every role. Valid roles currently in use:
conductor, scout, coder, writer, critic, cline, all.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable

SECTION_TAG_RE = re.compile(
    r'<!--\s*applies-to\s*:\s*([a-z0-9,\s_\-]+?)\s*-->',
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
SECTION_HEAD_RE = re.compile(r'^##\s+', re.MULTILINE)

RULE_FILES = ("AGENTS.md", ".cursorrules", ".clinerules")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parsing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def split_sections(text: str) -> Iterable[tuple[str, str, set[str]]]:
    """Yield (title, body_without_tag, applies_to_set) for each ## section.

    Any content before the first `## ` heading is yielded as PRELUDE and
    applies to everyone. Tag-less sections also default to {'all'}.
    """
    heads = list(SECTION_HEAD_RE.finditer(text))
    if not heads:
        yield ("PRELUDE", text, {"all"})
        return

    if heads[0].start() > 0:
        yield ("PRELUDE", text[: heads[0].start()], {"all"})

    for i, m in enumerate(heads):
        end = heads[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(heads) else len(text)
        chunk = text[m.start():end]
        first_nl = chunk.find("\n")
        if first_nl >= 0:
            title = chunk[2:first_nl].strip()
            body = chunk[first_nl + 1:]
        else:
            title = chunk.lstrip("#").strip()
            body = ""

        tag = SECTION_TAG_RE.search(body[:400])
        if tag:
            applies = {s.strip().lower() for s in tag.group(1).split(",") if s.strip()}
        else:
            applies = {"all"}

        clean_body = SECTION_TAG_RE.sub("", body, count=1)
        yield (title, clean_body, applies)


def filter_for_role(text: str, role: str) -> str:
    role = role.lower()
    # Legacy path: Cline plays every role at once and should see the full file.
    # Bypass filtering entirely for it.
    if role == "cline":
        return "\n\n".join(
            f"## {title}\n{body.strip()}"
            for title, body, _applies in split_sections(text)
        )

    out: list[str] = []
    for title, body, applies in split_sections(text):
        if "all" in applies or role in applies:
            out.append(f"## {title}\n{body.strip()}")
    return "\n\n".join(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Discovery (walk up from a target path; fall back to SWE/system-rules.md)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def load_rules(start_path, script_dir: Path) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
    """Find the nearest project rules file, or the SWE fallback.

    Returns (raw_text, source_path_or_None). Empty text means no rules found.
    """
    p = Path(start_path)
    if p.is_file():
        p = p.parent
    try:
        p = p.resolve()
    except OSError:
        return "", None

    while True:
        for cf in RULE_FILES:
            candidate = p / cf
            if candidate.is_file():
                try:
                    return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), str(candidate)
                except OSError:
                    continue
        if p == p.parent:
            break
        p = p.parent

    fallback = Path(script_dir) / "system-rules.md"
    if fallback.is_file():
        try:
            return fallback.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), str(fallback)
        except OSError:
            pass

    return "", None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prompt-ready formatter
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def rules_for(text: str, role: str, header: bool = True) -> str:
    """Return a prompt-ready policy block filtered for `role`."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    filtered = filter_for_role(text, role)
    if not filtered:
        return ""
    if not header:
        return filtered
    return (
        f"\n--- PROJECT RULES (role: {role}) ---\n"
        f"{filtered}\n"
        f"--- END PROJECT RULES ---\n"
    )

"""
chat_agent.py — interactive terminal planning session.

Examples:
    python chat_agent.py "G:\\Personal\\Dev\\Web\\Drone_Website"
    python chat_agent.py . "Let's plan adding a newsletter signup"

Commands inside the REPL:
    /read <path>     manually add a file to context
    /list [dir]      manually list a directory
    /tree            print the repo file tree
    /save            save the plan artifact
    /reset           clear conversation history
    /help            show this help
    /exit            quit
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from agents_md import load_rules, rules_for
from plan_agent import (
    HERE, discover_files, fetch_requested, parse_markers,
    invoke_planner, save_plan, build_initial_prompt,
    build_followup_prompt,
)


def run_turn(history, ensemble, root, quiet=False):
    prompt = "\n\n".join(
        f"### {m['role'].upper()}\n{m['content']}" for m in history
    )
    response = invoke_planner(prompt, ensemble)
    history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response})

    # Handle automated READ/LIST markers
    hops = 0
    while hops < 5:
        markers = parse_markers(response)
        if not markers["reads"] and not markers["lists"]:
            break
        req = markers["reads"] + markers["lists"]
        print(f"\n  📖 reading: {', '.join(req)}")
        content, _ = fetch_requested(markers, root)
        history.append({"role": "user", "content": build_followup_prompt(content)})
        prompt = "\n\n".join(
            f"### {m['role'].upper()}\n{m['content']}" for m in history
        )
        response = invoke_planner(prompt, ensemble)
        history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response})
        hops += 1

    return response


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Interactive planning REPL")
    ap.add_argument("repo")
    ap.add_argument("instruction", nargs="?", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--ensemble", default="plan-workflow")
    ap.add_argument("--save-on-exit", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    root = Path(args.repo).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir():
        sys.exit(f"❌ Not a directory: {root}")

    raw_rules, rules_src = load_rules(root, HERE)
    tree = discover_files(root)
    if not tree:
        sys.exit("❌ No files found.")

    print(f"📂 {root}")
    if rules_src:
        print(f"📄 {rules_src}")
    print(f"📁 {len(tree)} files")
    print("   Type /help for commands, /exit to quit.\n")

    history = [{"role": "system",
                "content": "You are a planning agent in read-only mode."}]

    # Optional opening instruction
    if args.instruction:
        history.append({
            "role": "user",
            "content": build_initial_prompt(root, args.instruction, tree, raw_rules),
        })
        print("planner> ", end="", flush=True)
        response = run_turn(history, args.ensemble, root)
        print(response)

    while True:
        try:
            user_input = input("\n> ").strip()
        except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
            print()
            break

        if not user_input:
            continue

        low = user_input.lower()

        if low in ("/exit", "/quit", "exit", "quit"):
            break

        if low == "/help":
            print(__doc__)
            continue

        if low == "/tree":
            for f in tree[:200]:
                print(" ", f)
            if len(tree) > 200:
                print(f"  … [{len(tree) - 200} more]")
            continue

        if low == "/reset":
            history = [{"role": "system",
                        "content": "You are a planning agent in read-only mode."}]
            print("🔄 Conversation cleared.")
            continue

        if low.startswith("/read "):
            rel = user_input[6:].strip()
            content, _ = fetch_requested({"reads": [rel], "lists": []}, root)
            history.append({"role": "user", "content": f"<manually added>\n{content}"})
            print(f"📖 Added {rel} to context.")
            continue

        if low.startswith("/list"):
            rel = user_input[5:].strip() or ""
            content, _ = fetch_requested({"reads": [], "lists": [rel]}, root)
            history.append({"role": "user", "content": f"<manually added>\n{content}"})
            print(content)
            continue

        if low == "/save":
            plan = next(
                (m["content"] for m in reversed(history) if m["role"] == "assistant"),
                "",
            )
            out = save_plan(root, args.instruction or "(interactive)", history, plan)
            print(f"💾 Saved: {out}")
            continue

        # Normal message
        history.append({"role": "user", "content": user_input})
        print("\nplanner> ", end="", flush=True)
        response = run_turn(history, args.ensemble, root)
        print(response)

    if args.save_on_exit:
        plan = next(
            (m["content"] for m in reversed(history) if m["role"] == "assistant"),
            "",
        )
        if plan:
            out = save_plan(root, args.instruction or "(interactive)", history, plan)
            print(f"\n💾 Saved: {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                       if d not in IGNORE_DIRS and not d.startswith(".")]
        for name in filenames:
            p   = Path(dirpath) / name
            rel = p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if p.suffix.lower() in IGNORE_EXTS:
                continue
            if _ignored(rel, pats):
                continue
            if includes and not any(fnmatch(rel, g) for g in includes):
                continue
            if excludes and any(fnmatch(rel, g) for g in excludes):
                continue
            out.append(rel)
    return sorted(out)

# 2. Selection — plan-file extraction, planner (LLM), keyword fallback
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def extract_keywords(text: str):
    words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{2,}", text)
    return {w.lower() for w in words if w.lower() not in STOPWORDS}


_SRC_EXTS = {
    ".py", ".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx", ".mjs", ".cjs",
    ".html", ".htm", ".css", ".scss", ".sass", ".less",
    ".vue", ".svelte",
    ".go", ".rs", ".java", ".kt", ".rb", ".php", ".c", ".cpp", ".h", ".hpp",
    ".cs", ".swift", ".scala", ".lua",
}
_CONFIG_EXTS = {".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".ini", ".cfg"}
_DOC_EXTS    = {".md", ".mdx", ".rst", ".txt"}


def _file_weight(rel: str) -> float:
    ext = Path(rel).suffix.lower()
    if ext in _SRC_EXTS:    return 1.5
    if ext in _CONFIG_EXTS: return 1.0
    if ext in _DOC_EXTS:    return 0.3
    return 1.0


def score_files(root: Path, rel_paths, keywords):
    scored = []
    for rel in rel_paths:
        try:
            text = (root / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        except OSError:
            continue
        low = text.lower()
        raw_score = sum(1 for kw in keywords if kw in low)
        if any(kw in rel.lower() for kw in keywords):
            raw_score += 5
        if not raw_score:
            continue
        scored.append((rel, raw_score * _file_weight(rel)))
    scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
    return scored


def select_from_plan(plan_text, all_files):
    """Extract mentioned filenames from an approved plan."""
    if not plan_text:
        return None

    full_matches = [rel for rel in all_files if rel in plan_text]

    seen = set(full_matches)
    base_matches = []
    for rel in all_files:
        if rel in seen:
            continue
        base = Path(rel).name
        if len(base) >= 5 and base in plan_text:
            base_matches.append(rel)

    mentioned = full_matches + base_matches
    if not mentioned:
        return None

    edit, context = [], []
    for rel in mentioned:
        if Path(rel).suffix.lower() in _SRC_EXTS:
            edit.append(rel)
        else:
            context.append(rel)

    if not edit:
        edit = mentioned[:3]
        context = mentioned[3:]

    return {"edit": edit[:8], "context": context[:8]}


PLANNER_SYSTEM = """You are a senior engineer planning a code change.
{rules}

Given a user instruction and a list of files, decide which files to EDIT and
which files to READ FOR CONTEXT.

Reply with valid JSON ONLY, no markdown, no explanation:
{{"edit": ["path1", "path2"], "context": ["path3"], "reasoning": "one sentence"}}

Rules:
- Paths must exactly match entries from the file list.
- "edit" should be as small as possible.
- "context" = files that inform the change but shouldn't be modified.
- If unsure, prefer fewer files.
- Respect any DEPRECATED FEATURES listed in the rules — never select files
  whose only plausible edit would re-add them."""


def plan_with_llm(instruction, rel_paths, raw_rules="", plan_text=""):
    scout_rules = rules_for(raw_rules, "scout", header=False)
    system      = PLANNER_SYSTEM.format(rules=scout_rules)

    listing = rel_paths[:MAX_PLANNER_LIST]
    listing_str = "\n".join(listing)

    plan_section = ""
    if plan_text:
        excerpt = plan_text[:MAX_PLANNER_INJECT]
        if len(plan_text) > MAX_PLANNER_INJECT:
            excerpt += "\n… [plan excerpt truncated]"
        plan_section = (f"\n\nAPPROVED PLAN (excerpt — for file-selection hints):\n"
                        f"{excerpt}\n")

    user_msg = (
        f"USER INSTRUCTION:\n{instruction}\n"
        f"{plan_section}\n"
        f"FILES ({len(rel_paths)} total, showing {len(listing)}):\n"
        f"{listing_str}"
    )

    if len(user_msg) > 12000:
        print(f"⚠️  Planner prompt is {len(user_msg)} chars (>12000). "
              f"Aborting planner call to avoid a 400 error.")
        return None

    try:
        r = requests.post(LLM_URL, json={
            "model": PLANNER_MODEL,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": system},
                {"role": "user",   "content": user_msg},
            ],
            "temperature": 0.1,
            "max_tokens": 600,
        }, timeout=60)
        r.raise_for_status()
        raw = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        m   = re.search(r"\{.*\}", raw, re.DOTALL)
        if not m:
            return None
        data = json.loads(m.group(0))
        edit = [p for p in data.get("edit",    []) if p in rel_paths]
        ctx  = [p for p in data.get("context", []) if p in rel_paths and p not in edit]
        if not edit:
            return None
        print(f"   planner: {len(edit)} edit, {len(ctx)} context")
        return edit, ctx
    except requests.HTTPError as e:
        body = ""
        try:
            body = e.response.text[:300]
        except Exception:
            pass
        print(f"⚠️  Planner HTTP {e.response.status_code}: {body}")
        print(f"⚠️  Prompt was {len(user_msg)} chars.")
        return None
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️  Planner failed ({e}) — falling back to keyword search")
        return None


def select_files(instruction, root, all_files, mode, explicit_files,
                 raw_rules="", plan_text=""):
    if mode == "explicit":
        if not explicit_files:
            sys.exit("❌ --mode explicit requires --files")
        edit = list(explicit_files)

        # Context = same-directory source files only. Docs, configs, and
        # binary assets don't help the coder understand the target.
        edit_dirs = {str(Path(f).parent) for f in edit}
        edit_set  = set(edit)
        ctx = [
            f for f in all_files
            if f not in edit_set
            and str(Path(f).parent) in edit_dirs
            and Path(f).suffix.lower() in _SRC_EXTS
        ][:8]
        return edit, ctx

    # Prefer extracting from the plan over re-planning with the 3B model
    if plan_text and not explicit_files:
        from_plan = select_from_plan(plan_text, all_files)
        if from_plan:
            print(f"   plan → {len(from_plan['edit'])} edit, "
                  f"{len(from_plan['context'])} context")
            return from_plan["edit"], from_plan["context"]
        print("⚠️  Plan mentions no files that exist in the repo; "
              "falling back to planner.")

    if mode == "grep":
        ranked = score_files(root, all_files, extract_keywords(instruction))
        if not ranked:
            sys.exit("❌ No files matched the instruction keywords.")
        top = ranked[:5]
        if not any(Path(r).suffix.lower() in _SRC_EXTS for r, _ in top):
            print("❌ Keyword fallback picked no source files.")
            print(f"   Top candidates: {[r for r, _ in top]}")
            print("   The instruction describes a concept, not a symbol.")
            print("   Use --files <path...> to specify targets explicitly.")
            sys.exit(1)
        return [r for r, _ in top], [r for r, _ in ranked[5:12]]

    plan = plan_with_llm(instruction, all_files, raw_rules, plan_text)
    if plan:
        return plan

    ranked = score_files(root, all_files, extract_keywords(instruction))
    if not ranked:
        sys.exit("❌ Planner failed and no keyword matches found.")
    return [r for r, _ in ranked[:5]], [r for r, _ in ranked[5:12]]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Prompt assembly
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def read_capped(path: Path, cap=MAX_FILE_BYTES):
    try:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
    except OSError:
        return None, False
    trunc = len(raw) > cap
    if trunc:
        raw = raw[:cap]
    try:
        return raw.decode("utf-8"), trunc
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return None, False


def _render_group(root, rels, budget, header):
    chunks = [f"=== {header} ==="]
    used   = len(chunks[0])
    for rel in rels:
        text, trunc = read_capped(root / rel)
        if text is None:
            continue
        block = f"\n=== {rel} ===\n{text}"
        if trunc:
            block += f"\n… [truncated at {MAX_FILE_BYTES} bytes]"
        block += f"\n=== END {rel} ===\n"
        if used + len(block) > budget:
            chunks.append(f"\n… [skipped {rel}: context budget reached]")
            continue
        chunks.append(block)
        used += len(block)
    return "\n".join(chunks), used


def _load_plan_body(plan_file) -> str:
    """Read the plan artifact and return its full body (uncapped)."""
    if not plan_file:
        return ""
    try:
        raw = Path(plan_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except OSError as e:
        print(f"⚠️  Could not read plan file ({plan_file}): {e}")
        return ""
    text = raw.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
    if "<details>" in text:
        text = text.split("<details>")[0]
    parts = text.split("\n---\n", 2)
    if len(parts) >= 3:
        text = parts[1]
    elif len(parts) == 2:
        text = parts[1]
    return text.strip()


def _format_plan_for_prompt(body, max_bytes=MAX_PLAN_BYTES) -> str:
    """Cap and wrap the plan body for prompt injection."""
    if not body:
        return ""
    capped = body
    if len(body) > max_bytes:
        print(f"⚠️  Plan body is {len(body)}B; capping to {max_bytes}B for prompt.")
        capped = body[:max_bytes] + f"\n… [plan truncated at {max_bytes} bytes]"
    return f"=== APPROVED PLAN ===\n{capped}\n=== END PLAN ==="


def build_prompt(root, instruction, raw_rules, edit, ctx, plan_section="",
                 ensemble="code-workflow"):
    budget = MAX_TOTAL_BYTES
    edit_section, edit_used = _render_group(root, edit, budget, "FILES TO EDIT")
    budget -= edit_used
    ctx_section, _ = _render_group(root, ctx, budget, "FILES FOR CONTEXT (read-only)")

    coder_rules = rules_for(raw_rules, "coder")
    plan_block  = f"\n{plan_section}\n" if plan_section else ""

    if ensemble == "search-replace-workflow":
        output_format = """OUTPUT FORMAT — SEARCH/REPLACE patches:

For each file you want to modify, emit one <<<PATCH>>> block:

<<<PATCH path="relative/path/to/file.ext">>>
<exact existing lines copied character-for-character from the file>
<<<END PATCH>>>

Rules:
- SEARCH must be copied EXACTLY from the file. Same indentation, same case.
- Include enough context that SEARCH appears EXACTLY ONCE in the file.
- REPLACE is what SEARCH becomes — includes the changed lines plus the
  anchor lines that must stay.
- Only edit paths under "FILES TO EDIT".
- Do NOT wrap in markdown fences.
- Do NOT re-emit the whole file. Only the lines that change.
- Emit ONLY <<<PATCH>>> blocks. No commentary.
"""
    else:
        output_format = """OUTPUT FORMAT:
For every file you want to modify, emit exactly one block:

<<<EDIT path="relative/path/to/file.ext">>>
<the COMPLETE new contents of the file>
<<<END EDIT>>>

Rules:
- Path must match a path from "FILES TO EDIT".
- Emit the full file content (not a diff, not a fragment).
- Do not wrap in markdown fences.
- If a file needs no change, do NOT emit a block for it.
"""

    return f"""USER INSTRUCTION:
{instruction}
{plan_block}{coder_rules}
{edit_section}

{ctx_section}

{output_format}
"""

ANSI = re.compile(r"\x1B(?:[@-Z\\-_]|\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~])")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Parse + validate + apply
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

EDIT_RE = re.compile(r'<<<EDIT path="([^"]+)">>>\s*\n(.*?)\n<<<END EDIT>>>', re.DOTALL)


def _clean_orchestrator_output(raw: str) -> str:
    """Extract the final agent's response from llm-orc's stdout noise."""
    if "📊 Performance Summary" in raw:
        raw = raw.split("📊 Performance Summary")[0]
    blocks = re.split(r'✓ [a-zA-Z_]+ \([^)]+\)', raw)
    final = blocks[-1].strip() if blocks else raw.strip()
    final = re.sub(r'^-{3,}$', '', final, flags=re.MULTILINE).strip()
    if final.startswith("```"):
        lines = final.split("\n")
        if lines[0].startswith("```") and lines[-1].strip() == "```":
            final = "\n".join(lines[1:-1]).strip()
    return final


def parse_edits(raw, fallback_file=None):
    raw = ANSI.sub("", raw)
    edits = {}
    for path, body in EDIT_RE.findall(raw):
        edits[path.strip()] = body.rstrip("\n") + "\n"

    if not edits and fallback_file:
        cleaned = _clean_orchestrator_output(raw)
        if cleaned and len(cleaned) > 20:
            print(f"ℹ️  No <<<EDIT>>> markers in orchestrator output.")
            print(f"   Treating full output as replacement for: {fallback_file}")
            edits[fallback_file] = cleaned if cleaned.endswith("\n") else cleaned + "\n"

    return edits


def validate_edit(root: Path, path: str, content: str):
    p = (root / path).resolve()
    try:
        p.relative_to(root)
    except ValueError:
        return False, "path escapes repository root"

    if not p.exists():
        if len(content) < 10:
            return False, "new file too short"
        return True, "ok"

    old = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    old_norm = old.replace("\r\n", "\n")
    new_norm = content.replace("\r\n", "\n")

    if len(old) > 800 and len(content) < len(old) * 0.5:
        return False, (f"output ({len(content)}B) < 50% of original "
                       f"({len(old)}B) — likely truncated")

    if p.suffix == ".html" and not content.rstrip().endswith("</html>"):
        return False, "HTML missing closing </html> — truncated"

    # Reformatting guard: catches whole-file re-emits that insert blank lines
    # or re-indent unchanged regions.
    if len(old_norm) > 500 and len(new_norm) > 500:
        matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, old_norm.splitlines(),
                                          new_norm.splitlines(), autojunk=False)
        ratio = matcher.ratio()
        size_ratio = len(new_norm) / max(len(old_norm), 1)

        if ratio < 0.75 and (size_ratio > 1.20 or size_ratio < 0.80):
            return False, (
                f"reformatting detected: only {ratio:.0%} of lines preserved, "
                f"size {size_ratio:.2f}x original. Refusing to write."
            )

    return True, "ok"


def apply_or_preview(root: Path, edits: dict, dry_run: bool):
    plan, errors = [], []
    for path, content in edits.items():
        ok, msg = validate_edit(root, path, content)
        (plan if ok else errors).append(
            (path, content) if ok else f"  ✗ {path}: {msg}"
        )

    if errors:
        print("\n❌ Aborting — validation failed:\n" + "\n".join(errors))
        sys.exit(1)

    if dry_run:
        print(f"\n🧪 DRY RUN — {len(plan)} file(s) would change:\n")
        for path, new in plan:
            p   = root / path
            old = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if p.exists() else ""
            sys.stdout.writelines(difflib.unified_diff(
                old.splitlines(keepends=True),
                new.splitlines(keepends=True),
                fromfile=f"a/{path}", tofile=f"b/{path}",
            ))
            print()
        return

    print(f"\n✍️  Writing {len(plan)} file(s) …")
    for path, new in plan:
        p = root / path
        if p.exists():
            old = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
            if "\r\n" in old:
                new = new.replace("\n", "\r\n")
            bak = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".bak")
            if bak.exists():
                bak.unlink()
            p.rename(bak)
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"  ✓ {path}")

def main():

    ap.add_argument("repo",        help="repository root ('.' for cwd)")

    if args.ensemble == "search-replace-workflow":

        def try_apply(response):

        if err:

            print(f"⚠️  First attempt: {err}. Retrying with whitespace correction…")
            retry_prompt = prompt + """

    fallback = edit[0] if len(edit) == 1 else None

    all_edits = dict(edits)

    edits = {k: v for k, v in all_edits.items() if k in requested}

             ".cline", ".next", "coverage", "target", ".vscode"}
TEXT_EXTS = {".html", ".htm", ".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx", ".css", ".scss", ".json",
             ".md", ".py", ".rb", ".go", ".rs", ".java", ".c", ".cpp", ".h", ".hpp",
             ".cs", ".php", ".sh", ".ps1", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".txt", ".xml",
             ".svg", ".vue", ".svelte"}

def sse(data):
    return f"data: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"


def now_id():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")[:-3]


def safe_read(path):
    try:
        p = Path(path)
        if p.suffix.lower() not in TEXT_EXTS:
            return None
        return p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
        return None


def web_search(query, max_results=5):
    if not SEARCH_AVAILABLE:
        return []
    try:
        with DDGS() as ddgs:
            return [{"title": r.get("title"), "url": r.get("href"), "snippet": r.get("body")}
                    for r in ddgs.text(query, max_results=max_results)]
    except Exception:
        return []


def find_project_rules(start_path):
    """Locate the nearest AGENTS.md / .cursorrules / .clinerules.

    Falls back to SWE/system-rules.md when a project has no policy file.
    Returns the *raw* text (un-filtered) — each agent applies its own role
    filter at prompt-build time.
    """
    text, src = load_rules(start_path, SCRIPT_DIR)
    if src:
        print(f"📄 Rules: {src}")
    return text


def build_tree(root, max_files=100):
    """Return a compact list of relative file paths inside root."""
    root = Path(root)
    files = []
    for entry in root.rglob("*"):
        if len(files) >= max_files:
            break
        if not entry.is_file():
            continue
        rel_parts = entry.relative_to(root).parts
        if any(part in SKIP_DIRS or part.startswith(".") for part in rel_parts):
            continue
        if entry.suffix.lower() not in TEXT_EXTS:
            continue
        files.append(str(entry.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"))
    return sorted(files)


def clean_output(raw, is_html):
    final = raw.replace("<!-- APPROVED -->", "").strip()
    if final.startswith("```"):
        lines = final.split("\n")
        if len(lines) > 2:
            final = "\n".join(lines[1:-1]).strip()
    if is_html:
        m = re.search(r"(<!doctype html>.*</html>)", final, re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
        if m:
            final = m.group(1).strip()
    return final


def make_diff(original, final, name):
    return "".join(difflib.unified_diff(
        original.splitlines(keepends=True),
        final.splitlines(keepends=True),
        fromfile=f"a/{name}", tofile=f"b/{name}", n=3,
    ))

def stream_agent(model, system_prompt, user_prompt, agent_name, tag=""):
    payload = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt},
        ],
        "stream": True,
        "temperature": 0.2,
    }
    start = datetime.now()
    yield sse({"event": "agent_start", "agent": agent_name, "model": model, "tag": tag})

    content_acc = ""
    reasoning_acc = ""
    try:
        with requests.post(f"{LM_STUDIO_URL}/chat/completions", json=payload,
                           stream=True, timeout=1800) as r:
            r.raise_for_status()
            for line in r.iter_lines():
                if STATE["stop"]:
                    yield sse({"event": "agent_stopped", "agent": agent_name, "tag": tag})
                    return
                if not line:
                    continue
                line = line.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                if not line.startswith("data: "):
                    continue
                data_str = line[6:]
                if data_str.strip() == "[DONE]":
                    break
                try:
                    chunk = json.loads(data_str)
                    delta = chunk["choices"][0].get("delta", {})
                    rc = delta.get("reasoning_content") or ""
                    cc = delta.get("content") or ""
                    if rc:
                        reasoning_acc += rc
                        yield sse({"event": "reasoning", "agent": agent_name,
                                   "text": rc, "tag": tag})
                    if cc:
                        content_acc += cc
                        yield sse({"event": "content", "agent": agent_name,
                                   "text": cc, "tag": tag})
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError):
                    continue
    except Exception as e:
        yield sse({"event": "agent_error", "agent": agent_name,
                   "error": str(e), "tag": tag})
        return

    elapsed = (datetime.now() - start).total_seconds()
    yield sse({
        "event": "agent_end", "agent": agent_name, "tag": tag,
        "content": content_acc, "reasoning": reasoning_acc,
        "elapsed": elapsed,
        "chars": len(content_acc), "reasoning_chars": len(reasoning_acc),
    })


# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Core pipeline (single file). Rules are filtered per role at each stage.
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _with_rules(base_prompt: str, raw_rules: str, role: str) -> str:
    block = rules_for(raw_rules, role)
    return base_prompt + ("\n\n" + block if block else "")


def run_pipeline_on_content(original_content, file_name, file_path,
                            instruction, project_rules="", tree_context=""):
    """
    Runs Conductor -> Writer/Coder -> Critic on a single file's content.

    `project_rules` is the RAW AGENTS.md text (not pre-filtered).
    Each stage filters its own role view via agents_md.rules_for().

    Yields SSE events. Final event is `file_complete` or `file_error`.
    Never writes to disk — caller decides.
    """
    tag = file_path or file_name

    # ── Stage 1: Conductor ──
    conductor_system = _with_rules(
        "Output EXACTLY one word: 'CODE' if the request involves programming, "
        "HTML structure, CSS, or bug fixes. Output 'COPY' if it involves "
        "marketing text, SEO, or prose.",
        project_rules, "conductor",
    )
    cond_content = ""
    for evt in stream_agent(
        MODELS["conductor"], conductor_system, instruction,
        "conductor", tag=tag,
    ):
        yield evt
        try:
            obj = json.loads(evt[6:].strip())
            if obj.get("event") == "agent_end" and obj.get("agent") == "conductor":
                cond_content = obj.get("content", "")
        except Exception:
            pass
    if STATE["stop"]:
        return

    workflow = "code" if "CODE" in cond_content.upper() else "copy"

    # ── Stage 2: Writer / Coder ──
    if workflow == "copy":
        agent, model = "writer", MODELS["writer"]
        sys_prompt = _with_rules(
            "You are a professional copywriter and editor. "
            "Rewrite the file following the USER INSTRUCTION. "
            "Output ONLY the complete updated file. No markdown fences, no explanations. "
            "Preserve ALL existing Tailwind classes, HTML structure, scripts, and forms exactly.",
            project_rules, "writer",
        )
    else:
        agent, model = "coder", MODELS["coder"]
        sys_prompt = _with_rules(
            "You are an expert software engineer. "
            "Output ONLY the complete updated file. No markdown fences, no explanations.",
            project_rules, "coder",
        )

    writer_prompt = (
        f"USER INSTRUCTION: {instruction}\n\n"
        f"FOLDER FILES:\n{tree_context}\n\n"
        f"TARGET FILE ({file_name}):\n{original_content}"
    )

    writer_content = ""
    for evt in stream_agent(model, sys_prompt, writer_prompt, agent, tag=tag):
        yield evt
        try:
            obj = json.loads(evt[6:].strip())
            if obj.get("event") == "agent_end" and obj.get("agent") == agent:
                writer_content = obj.get("content", "")
        except Exception:
            pass
    if STATE["stop"]:
        return

    # ── Stage 3: Critic ──
    critic_system = _with_rules(
        "You are an automated formatting validator. "
        "Output the ENTIRE file exactly as received. No conversational text, no fences. "
        "If perfect, first line `<!-- APPROVED -->` then the raw file. "
        "If wrong, output ONLY the corrected raw file.",
        project_rules, "critic",
    )

    critic_content = ""
    for evt in stream_agent(
        MODELS["critic"], critic_system,
        f"Original instruction: {instruction}\n\nUpdated File:\n{writer_content}",
        "critic", tag=tag,
    ):
        yield evt
        try:
            obj = json.loads(evt[6:].strip())
            if obj.get("event") == "agent_end" and obj.get("agent") == "critic":
                critic_content = obj.get("content", "")
        except Exception:
            pass
    if STATE["stop"]:
        return

    # ── Stage 4: Post-process + safety ──
    final = clean_output(critic_content, file_name.lower().endswith((".html", ".htm")))
    if not final:
        yield sse({"event": "file_error", "file": file_path, "name": file_name,
                   "error": "Empty critic output"})
        return

    if file_name.lower().endswith((".html", ".htm")) and \
            not final.lower().rstrip().endswith("</html>"):
        yield sse({"event": "file_error", "file": file_path, "name": file_name,
                   "error": "SAFETY: truncated output (missing </html>)"})
        return

    diff = make_diff(original_content, final, file_name)
    yield sse({
        "event": "file_complete",
        "file": file_path,
        "name": file_name,
        "workflow": workflow,
        "output": final,
        "diff": diff,
        "bytes": len(final),
    })

SCOUT_PROMPT = """You are choosing which files to edit based on a user instruction.

{rules}

Output ONLY a JSON object. No prose, no markdown fences.

Instruction: {instruction}

File tree (relative paths):
{tree}

Select up to {max_files} files that this instruction plausibly requires editing. Prefer source files over configs. Skip README, LICENSE, lockfiles unless the instruction explicitly targets them. Respect any DEPRECATED FEATURES in the rules above.

Output schema:
{{"files": ["relative/path.html"], "reasoning": "one sentence"}}
"""


def _run_scout(folder, instruction):
    """Shared scout logic. Returns (files_list, reasoning, tree)."""
    tree = build_tree(folder, max_files=120)
    if not tree:
        return [], "No text files found in folder.", []

    raw_rules = find_project_rules(folder)
    scout_rules = rules_for(raw_rules, "scout", header=False)

    prompt = SCOUT_PROMPT.format(
        rules=scout_rules,
        instruction=instruction,
        tree="\n".join(tree),
        max_files=MAX_BATCH_FILES,
    )

    try:
        r = requests.post(
            f"{LM_STUDIO_URL}/chat/completions",
            json={
                "model": MODELS["scout"],
                "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                "temperature": 0.1,
                "max_tokens": 500,
            },
            timeout=120,
        )
        r.raise_for_status()
        raw = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
        raw = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*|\s*```$", "", raw, flags=re.MULTILINE).strip()
        plan = json.loads(raw)
    except Exception as e:
        return tree[:5], f"Scout failed ({e}); falling back to first files.", tree

    valid = []
    for f in plan.get("files", [])[:MAX_BATCH_FILES]:
        if f in tree and f not in valid:
            valid.append(f)

    return valid, plan.get("reasoning", ""), tree

    def gen():
        STATE["stop"] = False
        project_rules = find_project_rules(folder)   # raw text

        if use_search:
            yield sse({"event": "search_start", "query": instruction})
            results = web_search(instruction)

                    for i, r in enumerate(results, 1)

        if search_block:

        results_summary = []
        for idx, rel in enumerate(files, 1):

                           "error": "Binary or unreadable file"})
                results_summary.append({"file": abs_path, "name": rel,
                                        "output": None, "diff": None,
                                        "error": "Unreadable file"})
                continue

            file_result = {"file": abs_path, "name": rel,
                           "output": None, "diff": None, "error": None}

                        file_result["output"] = obj["output"]
                        file_result["diff"] = obj["diff"]
                        file_result["bytes"] = obj["bytes"]
                    elif obj.get("event") == "file_error":
                        file_result["error"] = obj["error"]
                except Exception:
                    pass
            results_summary.append(file_result)
            yield sse({"event": "file_end", "file": abs_path, "name": rel})

        run_id = now_id()
        try:
            (HISTORY_DIR / f"{run_id}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "id": run_id, "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                "folder": folder, "instruction": instruction,
                "results": results_summary,
            }, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception:
            pass

        yield sse({"event": "batch_complete", "id": run_id,
                   "results": results_summary})

    resp = Response(gen(), mimetype="text/event-stream")
    resp.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"
    resp.headers["X-Accel-Buffering"] = "no"
    return resp

    payload = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": system}] + messages,
        "stream": True,
        "temperature": temperature,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
        "stream_options": {"include_usage": True},
    }

    reasoning = ""
    usage = None
    try:
        with requests.post(
            f"{LM_STUDIO_URL}/chat/completions",
            json=payload, stream=True, timeout=1800,

            r.raise_for_status()

                    yield {"event": "stopped"}
                    break
                if not line:
                    continue
                line = line.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                if not line.startswith("data: "):
                    continue
                data_str = line[6:]
                if data_str.strip() == "[DONE]":
                    break
                try:
                    chunk = json.loads(data_str)
                    if chunk.get("usage"):
                        usage = chunk["usage"]
                    choices = chunk.get("choices") or []
                    if not choices:
                        continue
                    delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
                    rc = delta.get("reasoning_content") or ""
                    cc = delta.get("content") or ""
                    if rc:
                        reasoning += rc
                        yield {"event": "thinking", "text": rc}
                    if cc:
                        content += cc
                        yield {"event": "content", "text": cc}
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError):
                    continue
    except Exception as e:
        yield {"event": "error", "message": str(e)}

    if usage:
        yield {"event": "usage", "usage": usage}
    else:
        prompt_chars = len(system) + sum(len(m.get("content", "")) for m in messages)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
plan_agent.py — read-only planning CLI. Produces a plan, does not edit files.

Examples:
    python plan_agent.py "G:\\Personal\\Dev\\Web\\Drone_Website" ^
        "How should I add a newsletter signup to the homepage?"

    python plan_agent.py . "Rename UserService to AccountService" --save
    python plan_agent.py . "..." --max-turns 8 --ensemble plan-workflow

The plan is printed to stdout. If --save is passed, also writes a Markdown
artifact under SWE/plans/ that codebase_agent.py can ingest via --plan-file.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from agents_md import load_rules, rules_for

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

try:
    from agent import AGENT_DIR
except ImportError:
    AGENT_DIR = HERE / ".llm-orc"

PLANS_DIR = HERE / "plans"
PLANS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

IGNORE_DIRS = {
    ".git", ".hg", ".svn", ".venv", "venv", "env", "node_modules",
    "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache",
    "dist", "build", ".next", ".nuxt", "target", "out", "bin", "obj",
    ".llm-orc", ".idea", ".vscode", "coverage", "htmlcov",
}
IGNORE_EXTS = {
    ".pyc", ".pyo", ".pyd", ".so", ".dylib", ".dll", ".exe", ".bin",
    ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".bmp", ".ico", ".svg",
    ".woff", ".woff2", ".ttf", ".eot", ".otf",
    ".lock", ".min.js", ".min.css", ".map", ".pdf", ".zip", ".tar",
    ".gz", ".7z", ".mp3", ".mp4", ".mov", ".wav",
}
MAX_FILE_BYTES  = 40_000
MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 160_000
ANSI_RE = re.compile(r"\x1B(?:[@-Z\\-_]|\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~])")
READ_RE = re.compile(r'<<<READ\s+path="([^"]+)"\s*>>>')
LIST_RE = re.compile(r'<<<LIST\s+dir="([^"]+)"\s*>>>')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Discovery (mirrors codebase_agent.py)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def discover_files(root: Path, max_files=500):
    root = root.resolve()
    out = []
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames
                       if d not in IGNORE_DIRS and not d.startswith(".")]
        for name in filenames:
            if len(out) >= max_files:
                return sorted(out)
            p = Path(dirpath) / name
            if p.suffix.lower() in IGNORE_EXTS:
                continue
            out.append(p.relative_to(root).as_posix())
    return sorted(out)


def read_capped(path: Path, cap=MAX_FILE_BYTES):
    try:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
    except OSError as e:
        return None, f"<read error: {e}>"
    trunc = len(raw) > cap
    if trunc:
        raw = raw[:cap]
    try:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return None, "<binary or non-UTF8 file>"
    if trunc:
        text += f"\n… [truncated at {cap} bytes]"
    return text, None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read/LIST protocol
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def fetch_requested(markers, root: Path, budget=MAX_TOTAL_BYTES):
    """Fetch content for READ/LIST markers. Returns (text_block, remaining_budget)."""
    chunks = []
    used = 0

    for rel in markers["reads"]:
        if used >= budget:
            chunks.append(f"\n=== {rel} ===\n<skipped: budget exhausted>")
            continue
        p = (root / rel).resolve()
        try:
            p.relative_to(root)
        except ValueError:
            chunks.append(f"\n=== {rel} ===\n<path escapes repo root; refused>")
            continue
        if not p.exists() or not p.is_file():
            chunks.append(f"\n=== {rel} ===\n<file not found>")
            continue
        text, err = read_capped(p)
        if err:
            chunks.append(f"\n=== {rel} ===\n{err}")
            continue
        block = f"\n=== {rel} ===\n{text}\n=== END {rel} ===\n"
        if used + len(block) > budget:
            chunks.append(f"\n=== {rel} ===\n<skipped: budget exhausted>")
            continue
        chunks.append(block)
        used += len(block)

    for rel in markers["lists"]:
        p = (root / rel).resolve() if rel not in ("", ".") else root
        try:
            p.relative_to(root)
        except ValueError:
            chunks.append(f"\n=== LIST {rel} ===\n<path escapes repo root; refused>")
            continue
        if not p.is_dir():
            chunks.append(f"\n=== LIST {rel} ===\n<not a directory>")
            continue
        entries = sorted(
            f"{'d' if c.is_dir() else 'f'} {c.name}"
            for c in p.iterdir()
            if not c.name.startswith(".") and c.name not in IGNORE_DIRS
        )
        chunks.append(f"\n=== LIST {rel or '.'} ===\n" + "\n".join(entries)
                      + f"\n=== END LIST {rel or '.'} ===")

    return "\n".join(chunks), budget - used


def parse_markers(text: str):
    return {
        "reads": [m.strip() for m in READ_RE.findall(text)],
        "lists": [m.strip() for m in LIST_RE.findall(text)],
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Orchestrator invocation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def invoke_planner(full_prompt, ensemble):
    venv = Path("H:/AI/Agents/SWE/.venv/Scripts/llm-orc.exe")
    exe = str(venv) if venv.exists() else shutil.which("llm-orc")
    if not exe:
        sys.exit("❌ llm-orc not found")
    cmd = [exe, "invoke", ensemble, "--config-dir", str(AGENT_DIR)]
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PYTHONUTF8"] = "1"
    env["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "utf-8"
    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        cmd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, env=env, encoding="utf-8",
    )
    out, _ = proc.communicate(input=full_prompt)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        print(out[-3000:])
        sys.exit(f"❌ Orchestrator exited with {proc.returncode}")
    # Strip ANSI + perf summary if present
    out = ANSI_RE.sub("", out)
    if "📊 Performance Summary" in out:
        out = out.split("📊 Performance Summary")[0]
    return out.strip()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prompt assembly
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_initial_prompt(root, instruction, tree, raw_rules):
    planner_rules = rules_for(raw_rules, "planner")
    listing = "\n".join(tree[:400])
    if len(tree) > 400:
        listing += f"\n… [{len(tree) - 400} more files omitted]"

    return f"""USER INSTRUCTION:
{instruction}
{planner_rules}
REPOSITORY: {root}
FILE TREE (relative paths — you may request specific files with <<<READ>>>):
{listing}

Analyze the instruction and produce your first response.
"""


def build_followup_prompt(requested_content):
    return (
        "The runtime fetched the files you requested. Continue your analysis.\n\n"
        + requested_content
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Saving
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

MAX_PLAN_ARTIFACT = 20_000    # cap on the plan body written to disk


def save_plan(root, instruction, history, plan_md):
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", instruction.lower())[:40].strip("-") or "plan"
    ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    out = PLANS_DIR / f"{ts}_{slug}.md"

    body = plan_md
    if len(body) > MAX_PLAN_ARTIFACT:
        print(f"⚠️  Plan body is {len(body)}B — capping artifact at {MAX_PLAN_ARTIFACT}B.",
              file=sys.stderr)
        body = body[:MAX_PLAN_ARTIFACT] + "\n\n… [plan body truncated]"

    conv = "\n\n".join(f"### {m['role'].upper()}\n{m['content']}"
                       for m in history if m["role"] != "system")
    out.write_text(
        f"# Plan: {instruction}\n\n"
        f"**Repo:** `{root}`\n"
        f"**Generated:** {datetime.now().isoformat()}\n\n"
        f"---\n\n{body}\n\n---\n\n"
        f"<details>\n<summary>Conversation history</summary>\n\n"
        f"{conv}\n\n</details>\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Read-only planning agent")
    ap.add_argument("repo")
    ap.add_argument("instruction")
    ap.add_argument("--ensemble", default="plan-workflow")
    ap.add_argument("--max-turns", type=int, default=5,
                    help="max planner<->read round trips (default 5)")
    ap.add_argument("--save", action="store_true",
                    help="save plan artifact under SWE/plans/")
    ap.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true",
                    help="suppress per-turn progress to stderr")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    root = Path(args.repo).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir():
        sys.exit(f"❌ Not a directory: {root}")

    raw_rules, rules_src = load_rules(root, HERE)
    if rules_src and not args.quiet:
        print(f"📄 Rules: {rules_src}", file=sys.stderr)

    tree = discover_files(root)
    if not tree:
        sys.exit("❌ No files found.")

    history = [
        {"role": "system",
         "content": "You are a planning agent in read-only mode."},
        {"role": "user",
         "content": build_initial_prompt(root, args.instruction, tree, raw_rules)},
    ]

    last_response = ""
    for turn in range(1, args.max_turns + 1):
        if not args.quiet:
            print(f"\n⏳ Turn {turn} …", file=sys.stderr)

        prompt = "\n\n".join(
            f"### {m['role'].upper()}\n{m['content']}" for m in history
        )
        response = invoke_planner(prompt, args.ensemble)
        history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response})
        last_response = response

        markers = parse_markers(response)
        if not markers["reads"] and not markers["lists"]:
            break

        if not args.quiet:
            req = markers["reads"] + markers["lists"]
            print(f"   → reads: {req}", file=sys.stderr)

        content, _ = fetch_requested(markers, root)
        history.append({"role": "user", "content": build_followup_prompt(content)})
    else:
        if not args.quiet:
            print(f"⚠️  Hit --max-turns ({args.max_turns}); returning last response.",
                  file=sys.stderr)

    print(last_response)

    if args.save:
        path = save_plan(root, args.instruction, history, last_response)
        print(f"\n💾 Saved: {path}", file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

export function activate(context: vscode.ExtensionContext) {
  try {
    const output = vscode.window.createOutputChannel("LLM Orchestra");
    output.appendLine("Extension activating...");

    const provider = new ChatViewProvider(context.extensionUri, output);

    context.subscriptions.push(
      vscode.window.registerWebviewViewProvider(
        "llm-orchestra.chatView",
        provider,
      ),
    );

    context.subscriptions.push(
      vscode.workspace.onDidChangeWorkspaceFolders(() =>
        provider.refreshRoot(),
      ),
      vscode.window.onDidChangeActiveTextEditor(() => provider.refreshRoot()),
      vscode.commands.registerCommand("llm-orchestra.runPipeline", () => {
        vscode.commands.executeCommand("llm-orchestra.chatView.focus");
      }),
    );
  } catch (e: any) {
    vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`Activation Error: ${e.message}`);
  }
}

class ChatViewProvider implements vscode.WebviewViewProvider {
  private _view?: vscode.WebviewView;
  private _activeRequest?: http.ClientRequest;
  private _manualRoot?: string;

  constructor(
    private readonly _extensionUri: vscode.Uri,
    private readonly _output: vscode.OutputChannel,
  ) {}

  public resolveWebviewView(webviewView: vscode.WebviewView) {
    try {
      this._view = webviewView;
      webviewView.webview.options = {
        enableScripts: true,
        localResourceRoots: [this._extensionUri],
      };
      webviewView.webview.html = this._getHtmlForWebview();

      webviewView.onDidDispose(() => {
        this._view = undefined;
      });

      webviewView.webview.onDidReceiveMessage(async (msg) => {
        try {
          if (msg.type === "ready") this._sendRoot();
          if (msg.type === "run") await this._handleRun(msg);
          if (msg.type === "stop") await this._handleStop();
          if (msg.type === "apply") await this._applyFile(msg.file, msg.output);
          if (msg.type === "pickFiles") await this._pickFiles();
          if (msg.type === "getRoot") this._sendRoot();
          if (msg.type === "selectFolder") await this._selectFolder();
        } catch (err: any) {
          this._output.appendLine(`Message Error: ${err.message}`);
          vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`LLM Orchestra Error: ${err.message}`);
        }
      });

      this._sendRoot();
    } catch (err: any) {
      vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`Webview Init Error: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  public refreshRoot() {
    this._sendRoot();
  }

  private _postMessage(msg: any) {
    if (this._view) {
      this._view.webview.postMessage(msg).then(
        () => this._output.appendLine(`Message sent successfully: ${msg.type}`),
        (err) => this._output.appendLine(`Message send failed: ${err}`),
      );
    }
  }

    try {

      const folders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders;
